messages:
Kai (Design): dropping a short thread for the vectors preview + export flow. Main asks: ensure row selection survives filter/sampling toggles, tidy export modal copy, and fix focus behavior when inspector opens. Gif: https://rwd-assets/preview-export-ux.gif

Lina (Eng): quick scan: persisting selection is straightforward if we track selected IDs separate from page state. Edge case: when a row is removed by a stricter filter, show it as "hidden" rather than removing selection silently.

Harper (PM): agree. UX: show a compact pill: "12 selected (3 hidden) · View hidden". Clicking View hidden should open a filtered view showing only the hidden IDs in context.

Kai (Design): copy nudge for export button: change from "Export" to "Start export" with helper text under the button: "Download link emailed when ready for large jobs". Also add an "Advanced" toggle with format (CSV/JSONL) + checksum option.

Sam (Accessibility): a11y notes: keyboard focus currently jumps to the modal close button when inspector opens, skipping the inspector header. Fix: move focus to the inspector's first focusable control. Also ensure the selection pill is reachable by Tab and is announced: e.g., <div role="status" aria-live="polite">

Lina (Eng): good call. We'll add aria-live to the selection count and to the export job status. Implementation: selectedSet + hiddenCount, and keep stagedFilters vs appliedFilters to avoid surprise exports.

Kai (Design): question: should changing rerank model auto-update preview scores? My preference: staged change that updates preview but doesn't change applied model until user confirms. Show a subtle "Unsaved changes" text near the model selector.

Harper (PM): staged is safer. Add explicit text in export modal: "Export will use the currently applied rerank model: rerank-v2" so users know which model will be used. Also record model id in the job metadata.

Sam (Accessibility): tooltips for relevance cells need aria-describedby and keyboard focus. For heatmap colors, add numeric labels and avoid only color to convey meaning. If you use patterns, make sure screen readers still get the numeric value.

Lina (Eng): backend notes: export endpoint accepts columns[], format, checksum boolean, model_id (from applied state), and selected_ids[] (optional). For large exports we enqueue a background job and send a presigned URL via email + NotifyBot message. We'll also allow an immediate streaming path for <=10k rows.

Kai (Design): small microcopy tweak for hidden selection banner: "12 selected (3 hidden by current filters). View hidden" and on hover show "Selecting hidden rows will include them in export unless you reset selection."

Harper (PM): acceptance checklist I'll add: preserve selection across filters, selection status banner, staged rerank with unsaved indicator, accessible tooltips and heatmap, export modal copy updates, and streaming vs background behavior.

NotifyBot: Export job queued: exp_7c3f. You'll receive an email and a channel message when ready.

Lina (Eng): I'll add a storybook page for the roving tabindex + selection persistence. Ping me after mock update.

Kai (Design): thanks! i'll post v2 with updated banner, button copy, unsaved indicator, and focus flow in ~2 hours :sparkles:

Sam (Accessibility): please include aria-live examples in the handoff notes so QA can verify announcements.
